packageRules.description: Group npm patch + minor upgrades into single weekly PR.

Wrangler major bumps require manual approval for ROUTINE upgrades (deploy surface, route config schema). vulnerabilityAlerts + osvVulnerabilityAlerts below override this for CVE-driven majors, which open PRs immediately regardless of this rule.
Sentry SDK major bumps require manual approval (public API: init, beforeSend, scope, integrations). Pattern matcher catches the whole @sentry/* namespace including future additions.
Pin GitHub Actions to digests + tagged majors.
